set.prevailing_wage_basis: U.S. Housing Act of 1937 section 12(a), 42 U.S.C. 1437j(a): any contract for loans or contributions under the Act must require Davis-Bacon wages for laborers and mechanics employed in development of the project, including a project with nine or more units assisted under section 1437f (Section 8) where the PHA and builder agree before construction. HACSM MTW funds are 1937 Act (Section 8) funds lent for development, usually with HACSM PBVs, which separately trigger Davis-Bacon at nine or more contract units under 24 CFR 983.153(c).
